$comment: Social cards content contract: only the words and images the cards show. A set of 1242x1660 images for Xiaohongshu or X. The platform goes in brief.target.surface (xiaohongshu: up to 18 cards, title counted in 字; x: at most 4 cards, headline and key evidence inside the centre 1242x1242 crop). The paper is the class on <body> (references/social-palettes.json), not content. The cover headline is the post title, word for word, and the cover carries a real photo or screenshot. The author's text is used as written: a short last line is fixed with layout, never by rewording. Two to five list items per card, one point per text card, each card mostly full.

title.$comment: The post title. The cover headline and every footer repeat it unchanged.

cards.$comment: In order. The first card is the cover: title plus image. A card with paragraphs is a text card, with items a list card, with heading and image a screenshot card.

image.$comment: Path to the real photo or screenshot. Never a stock image or a mocked interface.
